remarks_1999: Not recorded Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: 'White Birch' 1925. Note: O'Keeffe confirms date. White birch with green foliage." O'Keeffe wrote: "A little way from the dock [Lake George] there was a big old birch tree with many trunks. I have painted the foliage green and have painted it yellow many times"(*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 43). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on canvas mounted to Masonite'. Based on Crystal Bridges records and past conservation reports the work appears to just be 'Oil on canvas', not mounted to Masonite. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Crystal Bridges, 2025)
